properties.otherAdvice:
Seasonal road closures:

  • Kosciuszko Rd between Perisher and Charlotte Pass,
  • Link Rd between Smiggin Holes and Guthega,
  • Kings Cross Rd between Cabramurra and Selwyn Resort, and
  • Tooma Rd and Snow Ridge Rd between Khancoban and Cabramurra.

Chains must be carried in Kosciuszko National Park in winter (4WDs exempt).

All motorists should be prepared and equipped for sudden changes in road and weather conditions in Alpine area
